$comment: C3 migration fixtures. Expected values are literal and independent of the implementation. A decisions reportSha256 of "@report" is replaced at run time by the SHA-256 of the two-space JSON of the implementation report (it is an identity token, not an expectation). An expected value of null is not checked. Omissions are compared by identity (anchor and lowercase glob) only.

policy.$comment: Single source of truth for secret-bearing paths. Every generated control (Claude Read deny, Codex deny-read snippet, git pathspec excludes, detect/scan exclusions) is rendered from this file by scripts/render-permissions.mjs. Never hand-edit the rendered outputs; edit this file and re-render.

patterns.note: Includes .env.example. Agents never read any .env* file; scripts/env-keys.mjs extracts key NAMES only.
Script-only area: backups and merged .env.example may contain real values. Agents never read it.

contentRisk.$comment: Readable, but may embed real values. Agents may read structure; they must never reproduce values from these files in outputs or reports.
